notes: Hand-entered from the AWS pricing pages on the as_of date; not part of the weekly refresh. Check the sources before relying on a figure.

agentcore_runtime.notes: Runtime v2 consumption pricing. CPU is billed only while active (it scales to zero during I/O wait, e.g. waiting on the model); memory is billed for the session. Per-second billing, 1-second minimum, 128 MB memory minimum.

agentcore_runtime_v1.notes: Runtime v1, the default when platform_version is not set. Memory is billed for the whole session, idle time included, until the idle timeout ends it; v2 reclaims idle memory after 120 seconds.

lambda.notes: x86 on-demand. Billed for the full duration of the invocation, including time spent waiting on the model or tools.

foundry_hosted_agent.notes: Azure Retail Prices API, Foundry Agents 'Hosted vCPU Usage' and 'Hosted Memory Usage', eastus, effective 2026-02-01. Billed on the container compute consumed per hour.

foundry_prompt_agent.notes: No charge for creating or running Foundry-native (prompt and workflow) agents; model tokens and built-in tools are billed separately.

azure_container_apps.notes: Azure Retail Prices API, Consumption plan, eastus. A replica processing a request is active. Monthly free grant (180,000 vCPU-s, 360,000 GiB-s, 2M requests) not applied.

vertex_agent_engine.notes: Google Cloud blog: runtime price of 2025-12-16, Sessions and Memory Bank billed from 2026-01-28. The product is now called Agent Runtime.
